message.reasoning_content: Prices drop with each sale; opponents have no goods, likely won't sell. Sell 1 now keeps price high, but opponents produce later? Round 5 market now, round 6 market last. Selling 1 at 12 vs selling 3 gives 30 total for 3 units vs selling 1 now (12) and 1 next round (12) — but only 3 units total, 2 markets left. Sell 1 each round: 24 for 2 units; selling 2 now gives 22. Better to sell 1 now, keep 2 for round 6? Round 6 I can sell 2 at prices 11,10 = 21, total 33 for 3 units. Actually selling 3 now: 12+11+10=33. Same. But round 6 start cash devaluation floor(cash/100)*62 — selling later avoids holding cash? No, devaluation applies to cash at round start. Selling now means cash devalued 62% next round! So prefer sell_credit (promissory not devalued... promissory added after devaluation). So sell all 3 on credit: promissory 38.75M, added in round 6, no devaluation. Choice 6.
